_comment: Gemini via Vertex AI through LiteLLM. IDs and prices taken from LiteLLM 1.106.6's bundled price table (model_prices_and_context_window_backup.json), 2026-11-02 -- NOT from Google's documentation. Confirm in Vertex AI Model Garden / pricing before a paid run; 3.8-flash may be an introductory price until 2026-12-31 (third-party pricing guides say $1.50/$7.50 afterwards). Access tested 2026-11-02 with the gatekeeper-pilot service account: all three models answer on location 'global' (404 on us-central1). Default Gemini 3.8 Flash thinking used ~11x more output tokens on a short prompt; reasoning_effort 'low' keeps the answer and cuts cost ~11x.
